name: Coral Taurine
headline: Coral Taurine
description: A source of taurine, an amino acid that supports the normal work of the cardiovascular system and the health of eye tissue.
howToUse: Adults – 1 capsule a day with food.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.

fullDescription:
Provides taurine, an amino acid naturally found throughout the body that helps support normal cardiovascular function.*

TAURINE

Taurine is naturally produced by the body and is found in the heart, brain, muscles, and eyes. It plays a role in many normal physiological processes including metabolic function and electrolyte balance. Taurine also plays a role in bile salt formation and supports normal digestion and the absorption of dietary fats. Taurine additionally provides antioxidant support to help protect cells from oxidative stress.*
